{{Quote|Jaguada base reports that jump points are limited in that system, and that they are scanning for vagrant traces of the Jedi ship. They may be able to calculate possible escape vectors.|[[Appo/Legends|Appo]]|<ref name="DL" />}}
The '''Jaguada system''' was located in the [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Worlds]] region of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories's]]<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]],<ref name="OuterRim" /> far from major [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] and with limited [[Hyperspace jump point/Legends|jump points]]. It had one inhabited [[Jaguada/Legends|world]] with a single [[Jaguada's moon|moon]],<ref name="DL" /> and by [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]'' to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> its one [[Jaguada's star|star]] was dying.<ref name="DL" />
{{System-stub}}

==Description==
{{Quote|The Jaguada system, Lord Vader. More precisely, the moon of the system's only inhabited world.|First technician, to Darth Vader|<ref name="DL" />}}
The Jaguada system was located in [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Worlds]] region<ref name="EAOC" /> of the [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]]<ref name="OuterRim" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It lay along the [[Kamat Aegit]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] between the [[Ashas Ree system/Legends|Ashas Ree]] and [[Khar Delba system/Legends|Khar Delba systems]], while the [[Kamat Krote]] [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route linked the system to the [[Dromund system|Dromund Kaas system]].<ref name="TEA" />
